releases.notes:
This update doesn't have any major changes, other than the configuration can now be found at `snowundertrees.config.json` instead of `snowundertrees.json5` - old configurations will automatically be migrated to this new format.

- Refactored configuration screen using YACL.
- Restructured mod classes to be easier to maintain.

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XVnUIUAQ/images/63dab93d742aec317ba25e1d20efe9e38d32b6ad.png)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mineblock11/SnowUnderTrees/compare/1.1.1+1.20...2.0.0+1.20
